generic_tasks.instruction: Implement a volatility regime filter using a rolling window comparison of a volatility indicator against its own moving average.
Develop a candle pattern recognition utility to calculate body-to-range ratios and identify relative body size outliers based on a rolling lookback period.
Create a breakout detection utility that monitors price breaches relative to the high/low extremes of a identified reference candle.
Implement a dynamic risk management utility that calculates stop-loss and take-profit levels based on a volatility-adjusted multiplier.

integration_plan.phase_1: Validate data stream integrity for OHLC and volatility inputs.
integration_plan.phase_2: Deploy volatility regime filter as a global gatekeeper for signal generation.
integration_plan.phase_3: Integrate candle pattern recognition to flag potential entry triggers.
integration_plan.phase_4: Implement breakout logic with conditional execution based on phase 2 and 3 outputs.
integration_plan.phase_5: Apply risk management utility to all active positions and monitor for noise-floor sensitivity.
